pages.title: Maze Warriors
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Duel with tanks inside a changing maze in Maze Warriors. Bounce shots off concrete walls and avoid your own ricochets, since one hit decides the round. Collect weapon drops and battle the computer or a friend on the same keyboard.

pages.title: Magic Brick Wars
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Build defenses and send units into battle in Magic Brick Wars. Place bricks to shape the battlefield while managing the resources needed for your troops. Respond to the opponent's moves as your forces contest the map.

pages.title: Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Clear stacked shapes in Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match. Tap tiles to collect three identical designs and remove the set. Look around the three-dimensional arrangement for available matches until the board is empty.

pages.title: Brainrot Mob Clash 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather an army while running in Brainrot Mob Clash 3D. Avoid spikes and spinning saws, collect additional characters, and merge units to strengthen the group. Bring the resulting force into battles against enemy mobs.

pages.title: Monkey Bubble Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build turrets to stop invading bubbles in Monkey Bubble Defense. Pop attackers to earn cash, then buy new defenses or improve existing towers. Sell a turret when you want to invest its value in a different type.

pages.title: Snow Road Puzzle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Build snowy routes in Snow Road Puzzle. Move icy tiles to connect the road through each puzzle layout. Examine how the sections join and rearrange them to form a continuous path.

pages.title: Through the Wall
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Fit a stick figure through approaching cutouts in Through the Wall. Click to change the character's pose and align the body with the opening. Adjust before the moving wall arrives as later shapes become more demanding.

pages.title: Jigsaw Fantasy
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Assemble pictures in Jigsaw Fantasy. Choose a puzzle from the gallery or upload a photo to make a custom one. Drag the scattered pieces into their correct positions until the complete image is restored.

pages.title: Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Complete interlocking equations in Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition. Select numbers and place them in empty grid spaces so the arithmetic works across the puzzle. Use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to find the required values.

pages.title: Rent out - Landlord Tycoon
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: Build a property business in Rent out - Landlord Tycoon. Buy, sell, and manage homes and other buildings to collect rent and increase profits. Grow from a small portfolio toward larger apartments, commercial properties, and villas.

pages.title: Cards: Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Organize a deck in Cards: Klondike Solitaire. Build four foundation piles from ace upward, keeping each suit together. Move through the deal until every card has been placed in its foundation.

pages.title: BURGER CATCH
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Collect a requested burger in BURGER CATCH. Drag the tray sideways to catch the ordered ingredients while avoiding too many extras. Running out of time or making too many mistakes costs hearts, and losing them all ends the game.

pages.title: Candy Pop Mania
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Swap neighboring sweets in Candy Pop Mania. Make rows or columns of at least three matching items to clear them. Combinations of four or more create special tiles, and power-ups can help with difficult sections of the board.

pages.title: Battler
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Combine abilities in the card battles of Battler. Choose one of three characters and arrange skills into effective sequences, including highlighted special combinations. Use the editor and upgrades to adjust the abilities and equipment you bring into combat.

pages.title: Highschool Mean Girls 3
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style six characters in Highschool Mean Girls 3. Explore the wardrobe and accessories to create new school fashion looks for the cast. Put together outfits and build style credits as you work through their transformations.

pages.title: Emoji Match
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Match expressive designs in Emoji Match. Use the available puzzle settings to adjust the number of pieces and the challenge. Click or slide through the emoji puzzles and work toward completing each arrangement.

pages.title: Hexa Sort Master
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Place stacks of colored hexagons in Hexa Sort Master. Matching sections move together onto one tile and build towers that can clear from the board. Meet each level's goal across more than two hundred layouts.

pages.title: Fire And Water Birds
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Keep the birds airborne in Fire And Water Birds. Press the space bar or tap repeatedly to control their flight through obstacles. Stay in the air and clear as many barriers as possible to improve the score.

pages.title: Dino Shooter Pro
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight dinosaurs and hostile people on an island in Dino Shooter Pro. Aim your gun at the attackers and fire to stop them. Watch for enemies approaching as you try to clear the confrontation.

pages.title: Hunters vs Props Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Play either side of a disguise hunt in Hunters vs Props Online. Become an object and hide within the map, or search as a hunter for players concealed as props. Caught hiders are eliminated from the round.

pages.title: Hiding Banana Cat
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Keep the moving cat exposed in Hiding Banana Cat. Slide adjacent glasses into the empty grid space to stop one covering the character. React to its random movement and try to keep it visible for as long as possible.

pages.title: GP Moto Racing 3
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race motorcycles on large circuits in GP Moto Racing 3. Steer through the course against other riders while balancing speed and braking. Use the arrow keys to drive, the space bar to brake, and Control for nitro.

pages.title: Pirates Path of the Buccaneer
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Fight ship battles in Pirates Path of the Buccaneer. Tap to move your vessel forward or backward, then swipe and hold to aim its cannon. Release the shot to attack enemy ships and sea monsters.

pages.title: Bridge Dawn
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Pass through openings in Bridge Dawn. Use the mouse to guide your movement through the permitted spaces while avoiding contact with the surrounding track. Keep the attempt going to increase your score.

pages.title: Count Speed 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Gain speed by choosing useful gates in Count Speed 3D. Slide to steer through blue gates that increase your velocity. Avoid stop signs and discarded tires that slow the vehicle before you reach the end.

pages.title: Human Wheel
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Build a rolling team in Human Wheel. Start alone and gather people to enlarge the wheel, then steer around moving obstacles. Preserve as many members as possible on the route to the finish and its treasure chest.

pages.title: Rescue Boss Cut Rope
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Release the right ropes in Rescue Boss Cut Rope. Study the suspended boss and the room's traps before making a cut. Choose a sequence that brings the character to safety without dropping him into danger.

pages.title: Cut Grass
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Mow paths through lawns in Cut Grass. Swipe or use the arrow keys to steer the cutter across the grass. Work through the puzzle layouts and clear the vegetation to grow flowers.

pages.title: Grab The Sushi
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Catch a piece of sushi with chopsticks in Grab The Sushi. Watch until the food aligns with the tips, then tap to close them. You have only one chance, making the timing of that grab decisive.

pages.title: Hexologic
pages.creator: MythicOwl Sp. z o.o.
pages.description: Solve number-line puzzles on hexagons in Hexologic. Add dots inside the cells so the totals match the clues at the grid's edges. Check all three directions as you work out each hexagon's value.

pages.title: Sudoku Royal
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fill a nine-by-nine grid in Sudoku Royal. Use each digit once per row, column, and box while choosing from four difficulty settings. Pencil mode lets you record possibilities, and a hint can help with a difficult square.

pages.title: Potion Rush
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Match potion ingredients in Potion Rush. Form groups of at least three identical items to remove them and meet the board's objective. Work through more than two hundred levels with different goals and puzzle types.

pages.title: Sky Race
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Bounce between safe landing points in Sky Race. Adjust the trajectory with the up arrow, collect gems, and avoid the moving hazards around the edge. Hitting a hill or the outer boundary ends the run.

pages.title: Coin Craze
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Leap between moving platforms in Coin Craze. Tap when two platforms line up to carry the boy safely onward. Collect coins and useful items while avoiding a fall onto the spikes below.

pages.title: Christmas Panda Adventure
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Help Teddy reach Santa's house in Christmas Panda Adventure. Travel through a forest where a sorcerer has placed traps and hostile creatures. Clear fixed and moving dangers so the panda can continue toward his gift-packing work.

pages.title: Escape from Aztec
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flee with stolen treasure in Escape from Aztec. Change lanes, jump, and slide past tree trunks, rocks, and ruins while avoiding capture. Collect valuables during the run and spend them on power-ups.

pages.title: World Flags Memory
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find identical national flags in World Flags Memory. Turn over two cards at a time and remember the designs you reveal. Open matching pairs together and clear them before the available time runs out.

pages.title: Model Dress Up
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Customize a character's outfit in Model Dress Up. Choose clothing and tap a dress to change its color. Try the available combinations to create a complete look for the model.

pages.title: Wedding Planner
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dress both members of a couple in Wedding Planner. Choose from the available customization options for the bride and groom. Explore the game's different modes while putting together their wedding looks.

pages.title: Pixel Skate
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Skate through twenty-four obstacle courses in Pixel Skate. Use the jump and stop controls to manage each hazard on the route. On a keyboard, the up arrow jumps and the left arrow stops the skater.

pages.title: Knot Logical Game
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Swap hexagonal pieces in Knot Logical Game. Connect all the colored nodes by lining up the paths within the cells. Work through seventy-two levels and check how each exchange affects the surrounding connections.

pages.title: Stickman Shadow Adventure
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Travel through a shadowy world in Stickman Shadow Adventure. Jump or double-jump with the space bar and use three different attacks with A, S, and D. Follow the adventure set in villages where the light is fading.

pages.title: Princess Salon Frozen Party
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Aria prepare for a medieval celebration in Princess Salon Frozen Party. Follow the salon's beauty-care steps after her unexpected journey into the past. Use the available face and hair treatments to complete her preparation.

pages.title: Key Mouse
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Collect keys before time expires in Key Mouse. Tap to guide the mouse toward the next key and gain extra time when you reach it. Keep collecting to extend the attempt.

pages.title: Doll Magical Fashion
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Create a fantasy makeover in Doll Magical Fashion. Combine princess, mermaid, fairy, or hero elements to design the character's look. Choose clothing, hair, glittering accessories, and colorful makeup to complete the transformation.

pages.title: Sea Animal Transport
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Deliver aquatic creatures by truck in Sea Animal Transport. Drive the load to its destination and complete the transport levels. Use WASD to steer and C to change the camera while handling the vehicle.

pages.title: Chimpanzee Jigsaw
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Assemble a primate picture in Chimpanzee Jigsaw. Move the scattered pieces with the mouse and fit their matching edges together. Work from recognizable parts of the image until the chimpanzee scene is complete.

pages.title: Zombie Attack
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Defend yourself with a sword in Zombie Attack. Strike at zombies from the left or right using the corresponding screen side or arrow key. Watch their approach and turn your attacks toward the next threat.

pages.title: Indian couple wedding
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Style two couples for a shared celebration in Indian couple wedding. Choose Indian wedding clothes such as sarees, kurtas, and sherwanis for the brides and grooms. Combine the available outfits to prepare everyone for the ceremonies.

pages.title: Counter Battle Strike SWAT Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight soldiers and zombies in Counter Battle Strike SWAT Multiplayer. Choose from modes including team battles, free-for-all, and survival waves. Play against computer enemies or create and join multiplayer matches, managing your ammunition during the shooting.

pages.title: The game 13
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Create the number thirteen in The game 13. Select a numbered square to combine it with adjacent matching squares and raise its value by one. Continue arranging useful groups until you can form the target tile.

pages.title: DDT SUCKED INFINIT
pages.creator: marmota
pages.description: Shoot incoming enemies in DDT SUCKED INFINIT. Use the mouse to fire and build your damage through upgrades. Click the player or press the space bar to pause and access improvements such as firing rate.

pages.title: Knife Break
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Throw blades at breakable targets in Knife Break. Use the mouse to launch each knife into objects such as wood, a tire, a shield, or porcelain. Keep hitting the target to break it apart.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Survival The End Of World
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Survive among dinosaurs threatened by a volcano in Dinosaurs Survival The End Of World. Move through the environment and use guns against the dangers you encounter. Try the campaign or join friends for survival-wave battles.

pages.title: Bunny Balloony
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race to inflate a balloon in Bunny Balloony. Make your bunny blow it up until it reaches the cactus and pops. Play alone or compete with another player in contests set for one, two, or three rounds.

pages.title: Amazing Spain Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct six travel pictures in Amazing Spain Puzzle. Select a scene and choose from 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Fit the parts together to complete the selected Spanish view.

pages.title: Neon Watergun Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Pair matching pictures in Neon Watergun Memory. Turn over tiles and remember their locations to clear each board in as few moves as possible. Complete the pairs across four levels.

pages.title: Backflip Dive 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Perform backward aerial flips in Backflip Dive 3D. Use the mouse to control the jump from a high ledge and the rotation that follows. Judge the movement as you attempt the dive.

pages.title: Castle Light
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Light your way out of a castle in Castle Light. Guide the knight through rooms and activate all three lights in each one. Complete the lighting tasks to work toward the escape.

pages.title: Euro Cargo Transporter Truck Driver Simulator 2019
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Handle oversized loads in Euro Cargo Transporter Truck Driver Simulator 2019. Drive cargo trucks across off-road routes and deliver the freight to its destination. Control the large vehicle with WASD and use the space bar to brake.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work together through infected areas in Zombie Mission 3. Rescue hostages and collect data disks while fighting zombies and avoiding their traps. Two players use separate keyboard controls to solve platform puzzles and continue the mission.

pages.title: Find Animals V
pages.creator: Nj developer Studio
pages.description: Locate matching creatures in Find Animals V. Search the scene for the required animal designs and select their counterparts. Choose free play or a timed challenge to work through the visual search.

pages.title: Classical Hippo Hunting
pages.creator: TechionicsInc
pages.description: Aim a sniper rifle in Classical Hippo Hunting. Track the hippo targets and take precise shots while leaving other animals unharmed. Use the right mouse button to zoom and the left button to fire.

pages.title: Twin Ball
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Time your catches in Twin Ball. Tap as the moving balls line up with their catch points and work toward a higher score. Watch both sides of the play area so you are ready for the next ball.

pages.title: Connect Dots
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Join the marked points in Connect Dots. Draw through all the dots in each shape without visiting the same one again. Plan a route before starting so every point can be reached without retracing.

pages.title: Classic Trucks Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six vehicle pictures in Classic Trucks Puzzle. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout and arrange the sections into a complete image. Use the truck details to identify where each part belongs.

pages.title: Dumb Ways to Die 3 World Tour
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: React to a series of brief challenges in Dumb Ways to Die 3 World Tour. Complete minigames featuring the series' characters and earn coins for successful attempts. Spend the proceeds on restoring the town of Dumbville.

pages.title: Stack Challenges
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Build a rising tower in Stack Challenges. Tap to place each new block onto the stack and try to make it higher. Watch the alignment before adding another piece.

pages.title: Cube City Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Battle across a block-built city in Cube City Wars. Use weapons, vehicles, and airdrops against another player while also dealing with computer-controlled opponents. Both players have separate movement, firing, dash, and car-entry keys.

pages.title: Spike Avoid
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Keep clear of sharp hazards in Spike Avoid. Survive around the spikes to earn points and collect gems along the way. Use the gems to purchase other skins while trying to improve your best score.

pages.title: Best Battle Pixel Royale Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Choose a character and weapons in Best Battle Pixel Royale Multiplayer. Join player battles or team contests with friends, and optionally add zombies to the map. Use the available equipment to fight through the block-styled arena.

pages.title: Princess Winter Activities
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare two princesses for the rink in Princess Winter Activities. Choose clothes suited to their ice-skating outing and complete an outfit for each girl. Combine the available pieces before joining them for the activity.

pages.title: Geometry Neon Dash World Two
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Jump, fly, and flip through hazards in Geometry Neon Dash World Two. Navigate dark caves and avoid spikes as the course continues. Collect stars to unlock characters and work toward a better score.

pages.title: Aces Up Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Remove cards until only four aces remain in Aces Up Solitaire. When exposed cards share a suit, discard the lower-ranking one. Draw more cards from the stock and keep clearing the tableau while preserving the aces.

pages.title: Mermaids Makeup Salon
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Give two underwater characters new looks in Mermaids Makeup Salon. Apply lipstick, eye shadow, blush, and mascara, then choose hairstyles and clothing. Complete a separate makeover for each mermaid using the salon and dress-up options.

pages.title: Medieval Defense Z
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Protect your position from zombies in Medieval Defense Z. Use your archers to shoot the attackers and spend money improving their abilities. Keep the defense working as more enemies approach.

pages.title: ATV Cruise
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Ride across hills in ATV Cruise. Steer the quad bike over the terrain and avoid obstacles on the course. Keep moving toward the finish while handling the changes in the ground.

pages.title: Princesses Wedding Prep
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Style a bridal party in Princesses Wedding Prep. Start by choosing dresses, shoes, accessories, and makeup for the bridesmaids. Then select the bride's wedding dress and complete her look for the ceremony.
